title: On Automorphism Groups of (1,2)-Surfaces
summary: Let $S$ be a minimal surface of general type with $K_S^2=1$ and $p_g(S)=2$, called a $(1,2)$-surface. We give a geometric recovery and refinement of D. Wen's bound $|\mathrm{Aut}(S)|\leq 200$ using the canonical genus-two fibration and the double-cover model over the Hirzebruch surface $Σ_2$. Computing $\mathrm{Aut}(Σ_2)$ from its Cox ring separates the action on the base $\mathbb{P}^1$ from the vertical kernel.
